exercises.question: Which change is correct? [¿Qué cambio es correcto?]
options: «Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivía allí. [“I live here” → He said that he lived there.]
«Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivo aquí. [“I live here” → He said that I live here.]
«Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivirá allí. [“I live here” → He said that he would live there.]

exercises.sentence: «Estoy aquí» → Dijo que ___ allí. (estar) [“I am here” → He said that he was there.]

exercises.english: He said that he lived there.

sentences: Dijo que al día siguiente iba. [He said that he was going the next day.]
El cambio afecta al tiempo. [The change affects the time expression.]

exercises.question: Which word means «perspective»? [¿Qué palabra significa «perspectiva»?]
options: perspectiva [perspective]
conversación [conversation]
respuesta [answer]

exercises.sentence: Cada testigo tenía una ___ diferente. (perspectiva) [Each witness had a different perspective.]

options: “I live here” → He said that he lived there.
“I lived there” → He said that he lives here.
“I live here” → He asked if I lived there.

exercises.sentence: «Mañana voy» → Dijo que al día siguiente iba.
options: “I am going tomorrow” → He said that he was going the next day.
“I went yesterday” → He said that he was going tomorrow.
“I go tomorrow” → He asked where I went.

exercises.sentence: Cada testigo tenía una perspectiva diferente.

options: Dijo que vivía allí. [He said that he lived there.]
Dijo que vive allí mañana. [He said that he lives there tomorrow.]
Preguntó que vivía. [He asked that he lived.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué pasó con «aquí» al cambiar la perspectiva?

options: Se convirtió en «allí». [It became “there”.]
Se convirtió en «mañana». [It became “tomorrow”.]
No cambió nunca. [It never changed.]
Porque cambia la perspectiva del hablante. [Because the speaker's perspective changes.]
Porque no existe la conversación. [Because the conversation does not exist.]
Porque todo ocurrió mañana. [Because everything happened tomorrow.]

template.prompt: Report a sentence with a changed pronoun or place expression.
Report a sentence with a changed time expression.
template.answer: Dijo que al día siguiente iba.

template.prompt: Explain why perspective affects reported speech.
template.answer: Al cambiar la perspectiva, pueden cambiar los pronombres y las expresiones de tiempo y lugar.
